text:
zoe_cs: FYI - onboarding vector uploads failing for ~16 EU tenants. SRE says it's a cache-TTL regression after yesterday's runtime tweak. Need comms, credits, and localized banners.

dylan_sre: Confirmed root cause: unintended TTL reduction caused KV cache evictions; fallback to cold-store causes delays and some 503s. Hotfix rolled at +20m; gradual recovery observed.

omar_eng: Impact: uploads may return 503/504 briefly; existing vectors unaffected. We're rolling a full restart of affected pool; estimated full return in ~25m. Posting short RCA to incident page.

sophie_support: CS request: will customers see wrong results? Also need wording for in-console banner + email templates for renewals and trials.

dylan_sre: No model/result corruption. Only ingestion reliability. Recommended message: honest, short, offer 1x credit for failed jobs, optional troubleshooting session.

zoe_cs: Draft two templates: (1) High-touch for renewals -> personalized note + office hours link. (2) Bulk for trials -> short acknowledgement + self-serve steps. Keep first sentence <80 chars.

lia_l10n: I can translate into FR/DE/ES/IT. Need final English copy; turnaround ~90m. For banners keep <110 chars.

sophie_support: I'll add Zendesk macros: "ingest-failed-credit" and "ingest-offer-hours" with scheduling link and credit confirmation. Also will auto-tag tickets with "ingest-credit-queued".

zoe_cs: Who owns credit issuance and Gainsight flagging? I can take sends if you hand me the tenant CSV.

dylan_sre: @zoe_cs I'll upload affected_tenants_4723.csv to /secure-share/cs/ and add renewal_date flags. Hotfix completed at +20m; restart in progress. I'll update once >99% success for 15m window.

omar_eng: Quick FAQ draft: "Was data exposed?" -> "No. The issue impacted caching for uploads only; no data was leaked or altered. Stored vectors are intact."

zoe_cs: Perfect. Plan: send Tier 1 high-touch now to renewal-risk accounts (EN copy), queue credits, then wait for localized subjects from @lia_l10n before sending non-EN batches. Post send log here.

status-bot: incident-47234 updated: INVESTIGATING -> PARTIALLY_MITIGATED. Details: https://intra.redwood/incident/47234

sophie_support: I'll also include a short troubleshooting note for engineers: "If upload fails, retry with exponential backoff or use SDK v1.5.1 which auto-retries."

zoe_cs: Thanks team. I'll share the send cadence and the per-account personalization tokens in ~20m. :pray:
